name: Hartham Common Play Areas
description: Two play areas. The younger children's one has swings, a roundabout, a sandpit with water play in summer, a Viking swing and two bird-nest towers joined by a rope tunnel, with slides and rope ladders. The older children's one has a Freerider swing, rotators and a climbing boulder. Skate park by the main entrance.
